grammar.title: Hear the full verb inside a short ending
grammar.formation: Vてしまう→Vちゃう; Vでしまう→Vじゃう. Past ちゃった/じゃった.
grammar.explanation: Casual ちゃう/じゃう can describe finishing completely or an unintended outcome. Regret comes from the situation, not every use. Start with the verb’s te-form: 書いて→書いちゃう, 読んで→読んじゃう. These are common peer-speech contractions, not a separate set of verbs.
grammar.example: 早口の返事を聞き逃しちゃった。
grammar.translation: I missed the rapidly spoken reply.

examples.ja: {早口|はやくち}の{返事|へんじ}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}しちゃった。
examples.en: I missed the rapidly spoken reply.

examples.ja: {短|みじか}い{記事|きじ}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{読|よ}んじゃった。
examples.en: I finished reading the whole short article.

examples.ja: {準備|じゅんび}は{先|さき}にしちゃおう。
examples.en: Let us finish the preparation first.

grammar.mistake: Do not attach ちゃう to the masu stem: 読みちゃう is not the contraction of 読んでしまう.

grammar.title: Preparation and a current state sound different
grammar.formation: ておく→とく; でおく→どく. ている→てる; でいる→でる. といて/どいて are contracted te-forms.
grammar.explanation: とく keeps the preparation or leave-ready meaning of ておく; てる keeps the ongoing/resulting/habitual meaning of ている. Preserve て/で: 読んでおく→読んどく, 読んでいる→読んでる. Past 読んどいた and 読んでた remain different. Context tells whether でる comes from でいる or is the verb 出る.
grammar.translation: I will watch the preview beforehand.

examples.ja: {予告|よこく}を{先|さき}に{見|み}とくね。
examples.en: I will watch the preview beforehand.

examples.ja: {今|いま}、{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}を{聞|き}いてる。
examples.en: I am listening to spoken language now.

examples.ja: {資料|しりょう}は{先|さき}に{読|よ}んどいて。

grammar.mistake: 見とく is preparing, while 見てる is watching or an ongoing/resulting state. Do not collapse both into one meaning.

grammar.title: Recognise a shortened obligation
grammar.formation: Vない: replace ない with なきゃ or なくちゃ. Often omit following いけない/ならない/だめ. する→しなきゃ; 来る→こなきゃ.
grammar.explanation: A friend can end with 確認しなきゃ to say they need to check. なきゃ comes from なければ and なくちゃ from なくては in necessity expressions. Both are available to different speakers. They express a required action; they are not the prohibition てはいけない.
grammar.example: 始める前に、音量を確認しなきゃ。
grammar.translation: I need to check the volume before starting.

examples.ja: {始|はじ}める{前|まえ}に、{音量|おんりょう}を{確認|かくにん}しなきゃ。
examples.en: I need to check the volume before starting.

examples.ja: {明日|あした}は{早|はや}く{起|お}きなくちゃ。
examples.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.

examples.ja: {七時|しちじ}までに{来|こ}なきゃ。
examples.en: I have to come by seven.

grammar.mistake: しなきゃ means need to do, not must not do. Use the negative base, not するなきゃ.

grammar.title: Remember a plan; wonder about an answer
grammar.formation: Recall: Vた+っけ; V+んだっけ; N/na-adj+だっけ/だったっけ. Wonder: plain V/i-adj+かな; N/na-adj+かな.
grammar.explanation: っけ asks yourself or a familiar listener to retrieve something you once knew, including a future arrangement. かな wonders about an unresolved thought, though it can also soften an utterance to a listener. The taught nonpast verb recall uses んだっけ. A recalled date is not automatically a past event.
grammar.example: 視聴は何時からだったっけ？
grammar.translation: What time was the viewing from again?

examples.ja: {視聴|しちょう}は{何時|なんじ}からだったっけ？
examples.en: What time was the viewing from again?

examples.ja: {来週|らいしゅう}も{集|あつ}まるんだっけ？
examples.en: Were we getting together next week too?

examples.ja: {語尾|ごび}まで{聞|き}き{取|と}れるかな。
examples.en: I wonder whether I can catch the ending too.

grammar.mistake: Do not treat every っけ question as an event already completed. For the taught noun + かな pattern, do not insert だ.

grammar.title: A shared point and an explanatory question
grammar.formation: Statement+じゃん. Question: plain V/i-adj+の?; N/na-adj+なの? (rising delivery).
grammar.explanation: じゃん presents a point, reaction or shared confirmation among peers. It does not negate the preceding statement like predicate じゃない. Rising の? asks about an explanation or situation: 見てるの？. Nouns/na-adjectives take な: 好きなの？. The same written の can appear in explanatory statements; context and delivery matter.
grammar.example: 短い返事にも役柄が出るじゃん。
grammar.translation: The character role comes through even in short replies, you know.

examples.ja: {短|みじか}い{返事|へんじ}にも{役柄|やくがら}が{出|で}るじゃん。
examples.en: The character role comes through even in short replies, you know.
Are you watching the sequel too?

examples.ja: この{主役|しゅやく}が{好|す}きなの？
examples.en: Do you like this lead character?

grammar.mistake: Do not translate affirmative いいじゃん as not good, or confuse explanatory の? with a possessive noun link.

dialogues.title: A short Saturday viewing session
dialogues.scene: Saturday evening at home. Misaki and Bao agree to watch the Japanese audio at normal playback speed, starting the main feature at seven thirty, with a pause every ten minutes. They briefly recall Wednesday’s practice.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {水曜日|すいようび}の{発表|はっぴょう}、{森|もり}さんの{承諾|しょうだく}をもらってできたんだって？
lines.romaji: Suiyōbi no happyō, Mori-san no shōdaku o moratte dekita n datte?
lines.meaning: I hear you were able to present on Wednesday with Mori’s consent?

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: うん。{設備|せつび}の{不具合|ふぐあい}の{要因|よういん}は{調査|ちょうさ}{中|ちゅう}だって{伝|つた}えたよ。{議事録|ぎじろく}も{確認|かくにん}した。{今日|きょう}は{休息|きゅうそく}の{時間|じかん}にしよう。
lines.romaji: Un. Setsubi no fuguai no yōin wa chōsa chū datte tsutaeta yo. Gijiroku mo kakunin shita. Kyō wa kyūsoku no jikan ni shiyō.
lines.meaning: Yes. I said the factors behind the equipment problem are under investigation. I checked the minutes too. Let us make today time for a rest.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {七時半|しちじはん}から{本編|ほんぺん}を{見|み}よう。{予告|よこく}は{今|いま}のうちに{見|み}とくね。
lines.romaji: Shichijihan kara honpen o miyō. Yokoku wa ima no uchi ni mitoku ne.
lines.meaning: Let us watch the main feature from seven thirty. I will watch the preview beforehand while there is time.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {早口|はやくち}の{所|ところ}は{聞|き}き{逃|のが}しちゃうから、{十分|じゅっぷん}ごとに{一時停止|いちじていし}しよう。{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}は{短|みじか}くして、{間隔|かんかく}を{空|あ}けたい。
lines.romaji: Hayakuchi no tokoro wa kikinogashichau kara, juppun goto ni ichiji teishi shiyō. Hanpuku renshū wa mijikaku shite, kankaku o aketai.
lines.meaning: I miss the fast parts, so let us pause every ten minutes. I want short repetition practice with gaps between sessions.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {分|わ}かった。{毎回|まいかい}、{止|と}めた{所|ところ}を{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}して{再生|さいせい}しよう。{今日|きょう}は{速|はや}くしないよ。
lines.romaji: Wakatta. Maikai, tometa tokoro o makimodoshite saisei shiyō. Kyō wa hayaku shinai yo.
lines.meaning: Understood. Each time, let us rewind and replay the part where we stopped. We will not speed it up today.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {字幕|じまく}だけに{頼|たよ}らず、まず{日本語|にほんご}の{話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}を{聞|き}いてる。{吹|ふ}き{替|か}えは{選|えら}ばないよ。
lines.romaji: Jimaku dake ni tayorazu, mazu Nihongo no hanashikotoba o kiiteru. Fukikae wa erabanai yo.
lines.meaning: I am first listening to the spoken Japanese without relying only on subtitles. I am not choosing dubbed audio.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: さっきの{予告|よこく}を{見|み}{逃|のが}しちゃった？ {主役|しゅやく}だけでなく、{脇役|わきやく}も{出|で}てたよ。
lines.romaji: Sakki no yokoku o minogashichatta? Shuyaku dake de naku, wakiyaku mo deteta yo.
lines.meaning: Did you miss the preview just now? The supporting character appeared too, not just the lead.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: まだ{見|み}てない。{着信|ちゃくしん}に{応答|おうとう}してたんだ。{今|いま}は{携帯|けいたい}をしまった。{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}が{戻|もど}ってきたよ。
lines.romaji: Mada mitenai. Chakushin ni ōtō shiteta n da. Ima wa keitai o shimatta. Shūchūryoku ga modotte kita yo.
lines.meaning: I have not seen it yet. I was answering an incoming call. I have put the phone away now. My concentration has come back.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: じゃ、{準備|じゅんび}しとくね。{非公開|ひこうかい}の{仕事|しごと}の{資料|しりょう}はここでは{開|ひら}かないよ。{今夜|こんや}{見|み}る{話数|わすう}だけ{控|ひか}えておこう。
lines.romaji: Ja, junbi shitoku ne. Hikōkai no shigoto no shiryō wa koko de wa hirakanai yo. Kon’ya miru wasū dake hikaete okō.
lines.meaning: Then I will get things ready. We will not open nonpublic work material here. Let us just note which episode we are watching tonight.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: うん。{公開|こうかい}された{予告|よこく}を{見|み}てから、{本編|ほんぺん}に{行|い}こう。{休息|きゅうそく}の{合間|あいま}に{少|すこ}し{練習|れんしゅう}するだけで、{続編|ぞくへん}は{今日|きょう}{見|み}ないよ。
lines.romaji: Un. Kōkai sareta yokoku o mite kara, honpen ni ikō. Kyūsoku no aima ni sukoshi renshū suru dake de, zokuhen wa kyō minai yo.
lines.meaning: Yes. Let us watch the released preview and then go to the main feature. We are just practising a little between rests; we will not watch the sequel today.

dialogues.title: Remembering the plan and the actual viewing
dialogues.scene: Sunday morning, Kenta asks Misaki and Bao about Saturday’s viewing. He was not present. Misaki reports what they actually watched; Bao describes his practice goals.

lines.speaker: Kenta
lines.line: {昨日|きのう}の{視聴|しちょう}って、{何時|なんじ}からだったっけ？ {予告|よこく}だけ{見|み}たの？
lines.romaji: Kinō no shichō tte, nanji kara datta kke? Yokoku dake mita no?
lines.meaning: What time was yesterday’s viewing from again? Did you only watch the preview?

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {七時半|しちじはん}から{本編|ほんぺん}も{見|み}たよ。{早口|はやくち}の{場面|ばめん}は{十分|じゅっぷん}ごとに{止|と}めて、{語尾|ごび}を{聞|き}き{直|なお}した。
lines.romaji: Shichijihan kara honpen mo mita yo. Hayakuchi no bamen wa juppun goto ni tomete, gobi o kikinaoshita.
lines.meaning: We watched the main feature too, from seven thirty. We paused every ten minutes at fast scenes and listened to the endings again.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {話|はな}し{言葉|ことば}はくだけてるけど、{全部|ぜんぶ}が{間違|まちが}いじゃない。{相|あい}づちとつぶやきも{区別|くべつ}できるかな。
lines.romaji: Hanashikotoba wa kudaketeru kedo, zenbu ga machigai ja nai. Aizuchi to tsubuyaki mo kubetsu dekiru kana.
lines.meaning: The spoken language is informal, but that does not make it all wrong. I wonder whether I can distinguish backchannel responses and muttering too.

lines.speaker: Kenta
lines.line: {短|みじか}い{返事|へんじ}にも{役柄|やくがら}が{出|で}るじゃん。{僕|ぼく}が{金曜日|きんようび}に{見|み}た{予告|よこく}では、{主役|しゅやく}より{脇役|わきやく}の{方|ほう}が、{言|い}い{直|なお}すことが{多|おお}かったね。
lines.romaji: Mijikai henji ni mo yakugara ga deru jan. Boku ga kin’yōbi ni mita yokoku de wa, shuyaku yori wakiyaku no hō ga, iinaosu koto ga ōkatta ne.
lines.meaning: The role comes through even in short replies, you know. In the preview I saw on Friday, the supporting character corrected what they said more often than the lead.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: うん。{筋書|すじが}きはまだ{途中|とちゅう}。{結末|けつまつ}は{次|つぎ}に{見|み}よう。{昨日|きのう}は{続編|ぞくへん}を{見|み}てないよ。
lines.romaji: Un. Sujigaki wa mada tochū. Ketsumatsu wa tsugi ni miyō. Kinō wa zokuhen o mitenai yo.
lines.meaning: Yes. We are still partway through the plot. Let us watch the ending next time. We did not watch the sequel yesterday.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: うっかり{大事|だいじ}な{所|ところ}を{省|はぶ}いちゃったから、メモに{残|のこ}しといた。{次|つぎ}は{短|みじか}い{要約|ようやく}でも、{語尾|ごび}まで{確認|かくにん}しなきゃ。
lines.romaji: Ukkari daiji na tokoro o habuichatta kara, memo ni nokoshitoita. Tsugi wa mijikai yōyaku demo, gobi made kakunin shinakya.
lines.meaning: I inadvertently left an important part out, so I left a note about it beforehand. Next time I need to check through the ending even in a short summary.

lines.speaker: Kenta
lines.line: {音量|おんりょう}は{控|ひか}えてたの？ {僕|ぼく}は{音|おと}が{小|ちい}さいと{注意散漫|ちゅういさんまん}になるから、{最初|さいしょ}に{確認|かくにん}したい。
lines.romaji: Onryō wa hikaeteta no? Boku wa oto ga chiisai to chūi sanman ni naru kara, saisho ni kakunin shitai.
lines.meaning: Were you keeping the volume down? I lose focus when the sound is quiet, so I would like to check it first.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {小|ちい}さくしたけど、{台詞|せりふ}は{聞|き}こえたよ。{倍速|ばいそく}にせず、{合図|あいず}で{元|もと}の{場面|ばめん}に{戻|もど}した。
lines.romaji: Chiisaku shita kedo, serifu wa kikoeta yo. Baisoku ni sezu, aizu de moto no bamen ni modoshita.
lines.meaning: We lowered it, but could hear the lines. We did not use double speed; we went back to the scene when signalled.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {次回|じかい}も、{疲労|ひろう}や{眠気|ねむけ}が{出|で}たら{短|みじか}い{休息|きゅうそく}を{入|い}れよう。{毎回|まいかい}の{間隔|かんかく}を{記録|きろく}するのは{日課|にっか}になってる。
lines.romaji: Jikai mo, hirō ya nemuke ga detara mijikai kyūsoku o ire yō. Maikai no kankaku o kiroku suru no wa nikka ni natteru.
lines.meaning: Next time too, let us take a short rest if fatigue or sleepiness appears. Recording the gaps each time has become a daily routine.

lines.speaker: Kenta
lines.line: いいじゃん。{今度|こんど}は{僕|ぼく}も{参加|さんか}したい。{曜日|ようび}と{時間|じかん}を{控|ひか}えとくね。
lines.romaji: Ii jan. Kondo wa boku mo sanka shitai. Yōbi to jikan o hikaetoku ne.
lines.meaning: That sounds good. I would like to join next time too. I will note down the day and time beforehand.

readings.title: A viewing record; the next day is not set
paragraphs: ケンタへ。{日曜日|にちようび}の{朝|あさ}に{話|はな}した{視聴|しちょう}の{記録|きろく}を{送|おく}るね。{土曜日|どようび}は{七時半|しちじはん}から{本編|ほんぺん}を{見|み}たよ。{予告|よこく}はその{前|まえ}に{見|み}といた。{十分|じゅっぷん}ごとに{一時停止|いちじていし}して、{早口|はやくち}の{場面|ばめん}を{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}した。{倍速|ばいそく}にはしてないし、{続編|ぞくへん}もまだ{見|み}てない。
バオは{着信|ちゃくしん}に{応答|おうとう}していて、{最初|さいしょ}の{予告|よこく}を{見|み}{逃|のが}しちゃった。{携帯|けいたい}をしまってから、もう{一度|いちど}{見|み}たよ。{小|ちい}さな{音量|おんりょう}でも{台詞|せりふ}は{聞|き}こえた。{分|わ}からない{語尾|ごび}はメモに{残|のこ}して、{毎回|まいかい}{確認|かくにん}することにした。

grammar: とく/どく vs てる/でる
じゃん and explanatory の?
watch.prompt: Optionally save a contracted line from your own clip. Write its full form and identify the speaker and listener. Listen for the ending before checking subtitles.

exercises.prompt: When will they start the main feature?
exercises.explain: Misaki proposes 七時半から本編; Wednesday refers to the earlier practice.

exercises.prompt: How will they handle fast speech?
options: Pause every ten minutes and replay the stopped part
Keep watching the sequel without pausing
exercises.explain: They agree on 十分ごとに一時停止 and rewind/replay; Misaki says she will not speed it up.

exercises.prompt: Why has Bao not seen the first preview?
options: He was copying the minutes in the room
He had already seen the sequel
He was answering an incoming call
exercises.explain: Bao explains 着信に応答してた; that is why he missed it.

exercises.context: Form practice: shorten 読んでしまった to its named casual contraction.
exercises.line: {議事録|ぎじろく}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{読|よ}ん＿＿。
exercises.explain: 読んで ends with で: でしまった→じゃった.

exercises.context: Form practice: use the named preparatory contraction of 見ておく, not the ongoing form.
exercises.line: {先|さき}に{予告|よこく}を{見|み}＿＿ね。
exercises.explain: 見ておく→見とく. 見てる describes watching/a state; 見ちゃった is past completion.

exercises.context: Your friend says they missed the preview while answering a call. Suggest replaying it before the main feature.
exercises.line: {着信|ちゃくしん}に{応答|おうとう}してて、{予告|よこく}を{見|み}{逃|のが}しちゃった。
options: じゃ、{予告|よこく}はもう{全部|ぜんぶ}{見|み}たんだね。
じゃ、{続編|ぞくへん}まで{終|お}わったんだね。
じゃ、{本編|ほんぺん}の{前|まえ}にもう{一度|いちど}{見|み}よう。
exercises.explain: The first offers a replay. The others falsely treat unseen material as already watched.

exercises.meaning: Before viewing, I need to decide the rest times. Use 決めなきゃ.
exercises.explain: 決めない→決めなきゃ. This is the speaker’s obligation, not a prohibition.

exercises.prompt: What does Misaki say they did NOT watch on Saturday?
exercises.explain: She explicitly says 昨日は続編を見てない; they watched both preview and main feature.

exercises.prompt: What is Bao wondering whether he can distinguish?
options: Permission and compulsion at the workplace
The day and time already set for next week
exercises.explain: Bao says 相づちとつぶやきも区別できるかな; it is his unresolved learning question.

options: At a lowered but audible volume, without double speed
exercises.explain: Misaki says 台詞は聞こえた and 倍速にせず.

exercises.context: Form practice: ask a familiar friend to recall the agreed time, using the named だったっけ pattern.
exercises.line: {視聴|しちょう}は{七時半|しちじはん}から＿＿？
exercises.explain: For noun/time recall, だった+っけ. This can recall an arrangement, not only a past action.

exercises.context: Form practice: use the explanatory casual の question after the na-adjective 好き.
exercises.line: この{主役|しゅやく}が{好|す}き＿＿？
exercises.explain: 好き is na-adjectival: 好きなの？. Verbs/i-adjectives attach の directly.

exercises.context: Your friend feels sleepy. Propose taking a short rest before the next scene, without dismissing the tiredness.
options: じゃ、{眠気|ねむけ}は{全|まった}くないんだね。
じゃ、{音量|おんりょう}はもう{決|き}まったんだね。
じゃ、{次|つぎ}の{場面|ばめん}の{前|まえ}に{短|みじか}い{休息|きゅうそく}を{入|い}れよう。
exercises.explain: The first answers the reported sleepiness with a rest. The other replies deny it or change the topic.

exercises.line: {小|ちい}さくしたけど、{台詞|せりふ}は{聞|き}こえたよ。{倍速|ばいそく}にせず、{合図|あいず}で{元|もと}の{場面|ばめん}に{戻|もど}した。
exercises.prompt: Who reports that the lines were audible and the scene was replayed on a signal?
exercises.explain: This exact line is Misaki’s response to Kenta’s volume question. Kenta was not present; Bao follows with a rest suggestion.

exercises.meaning: I will note the ending beforehand and check it each time. Use the contracted preparatory 残しといて.
tiles: メモに{残|のこ}しといて、
exercises.explain: 残しておいて→残しといて prepares a note for later checking.

exercises.prompt: What date/time does the message report as the actual main-feature viewing?
exercises.explain: The message is sent Sunday morning, but explicitly reports Saturday seven thirty.

exercises.prompt: What is the status of their next viewing day?
options: It is a workplace assignment on Wednesday
It has not been decided; Misaki will contact Kenta after deciding
exercises.explain: 次の予定は、まだ決まってない and 曜日を決めたら連絡する distinguish unset plans from remembered Saturday.

exercises.prompt: What did Bao do after putting away the phone?
options: Watched the sequel at double speed
exercises.explain: 携帯をしまってから、もう一度見た refers back to the missed preview.
